extension.description: Unofficial Kodi Amazon Music Add-on - Kodi extention to browse and play Amazon Music songs. An Amazon account is necessary. Inputstream Adaptiv needs to be activated and the latest widevine verion installed.
extension.disclaimer: Some parts of this addon may not be legal in your country of residence - please check with your local laws before installing. All used images are from Amazon.
extension.news: v2.0.0 - Continues spacy's add-on, which is no longer developed, under an own add-on id: you have to sign in once more. - Functionality of the old add-on restored (e.g. login works again). - Important: Playback needs Kodi for Android; on desktop Amazon refuses the DRM licence. - Removed: Stations, genres and the recently played songs. Amazon has withdrawn the services behind them. - New: The path to the current folder is shown top left. - New: A title Amazon does not stream says so, instead of reporting a missing URL. - Translations revised. - Several small bug fixes.
